name: CreateMeetingTrans

parameters.help_en: Capability extension
parameters.help_zh: 能力扩展
parameters.name: ability_params

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the project created in the console
parameters.help_zh: 管控台创建的项目AppKey
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en: Additional parameters for ASR transcription, such as vocabulary_id for hotwords.
parameters.help_zh: ASR转写的额外参数，如热词vocabulary_id
parameters.name: asr_params

parameters.help_en: Audio bit depth for meeting uploads. Currently supported value is 16.
parameters.help_zh: 会议上传音频采样位数，当前支持：16
parameters.name: audio_bit_rate

parameters.help_en: Audio encoding format: PCM (uncompressed PCM or WAV file) or OPUS (compressed OPUS file).
parameters.help_zh: 音频编码格式，PCM（无压缩的PCM文件或WAV文件）或OPUS（压缩的OPUS文件）
parameters.name: audio_format

parameters.help_en:
The language model used for Audio transcription.  
cn: Chinese.  
en: English.  
yue: Cantonese.  
fspk: Free switching between Chinese and English
parameters.help_zh:
音频转写使用的语言模型。
cn：中文。
en：英文。
yue：粤语。
fspk：中英文自由说
parameters.name: audio_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable real-time transcoding to MP3 format. Default is false.
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启mp3格式音频同步转码，默认是false
parameters.name: audio_output_enabled

parameters.help_en: When audio synchronization and transcoding are enabled, the OSS Bucket to which the transcoded audio is written. This must match the OSS Bucket configured in the project settings in the console.
parameters.help_zh: 开启音频同步转码时，转码音频写入到的OSS Bucket，需要与管控台项目配置的OSS Bucket一致
parameters.name: audio_output_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: When audio synchronization transcoding is enabled, this parameter specifies the OSS file path to which the transcoded audio is written. The path must have the prefix "tingwu/"
parameters.help_zh: 开启音频同步转码时，转码音频写入到的OSS文件路径，需要以"tingwu/"为前缀
parameters.name: audio_output_oss_path

parameters.help_en: Audio packaging method. Set to "multi" when encapsulating multiple audio streams using the Protobuf format based on the Tingwu convention
parameters.help_zh: 音频打包方式，基于听悟约定的Protobuf格式封装多路音频流时设置为multi
parameters.name: audio_package

parameters.help_en: Audio sampling rate. Currently supported values are 16000 and 8000 (8000 supports only single-channel Chinese audio).
parameters.help_zh: 音频采样率，当前支持：16000、8000（仅支持单路中文）
parameters.name: audio_sample_rate

parameters.help_en: When post-meeting intelligent fetch is enabled, this parameter specifies whether to enable writing detection results of valid audio segments. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 开启会后智能提取时，是否开启有效音频片断检测结果写入，默认是false
parameters.name: audio_segments_enabled

parameters.help_en: When Intelligent Post-meeting Extraction is enabled, specifies whether in-meeting recognition results are written. Default is false.
parameters.help_zh: 开启会后智能提取时，是否会中识别结果写入，默认是false
parameters.name: doc_result_enabled

parameters.help_en: System extension: experiment transcription parameters
parameters.help_zh: 系统扩展：实验转写参数
parameters.name: lab_params

parameters.help_en: The meeting identity set by the User, which will be returned unchanged in queries during the meeting or in the End callback after the meeting
parameters.help_zh: 用户设置的会议标识，在会中查询或会后结束回调时会原样返回
parameters.name: meeting_key

parameters.help_en: Whether to enable Intelligent post-meeting extraction. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启会后智能提取，默认是false
parameters.name: meeting_result_enabled

parameters.help_en: The OSS Bucket to which the extraction results are written when Intelligent post-meeting extraction is enabled. It must match the OSS Bucket configured for the project in the console
parameters.help_zh: 开启会后智能提取时，提取结果写入到的OSS Bucket，需要与管控台项目配置的OSS Bucket一致
parameters.name: meeting_result_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The OSS File Path to which the extraction results are written when Intelligent post-meeting extraction is enabled. It must have the prefix "tingwu/"
parameters.help_zh: 开启会后智能提取时，提取结果写入到的OSS文件路径，需要以"tingwu/"为前缀
parameters.name: meeting_result_oss_path

parameters.help_en:
When real-time result return during the meeting is enabled and the audio packaging method is set to multi, this parameter specifies the level of speaker identification result return. The default value is 1.  
0: Do not return Classification Result.  
1: Return Classification Result when a complete sentence is detected.  
2: Return Classification Result for both intermediate results and complete sentences
parameters.help_zh:
开启会中实时结果返回且音频打包方式为multi时，设置发言人识别结果返回等级，默认是1。
0：不返回识别结果。
1：识别出完整句子时返回识别结果。
2：识别出中间结果及完整句子时返回识别结果
parameters.name: realtime_active_result_level

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable real-time result return during the meeting. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启会中实时结果返回，默认是true
parameters.name: realtime_result_enabled

parameters.help_en:
When real-time result return during a meeting is enabled, this parameter sets the level of recognition result returned. The default value is 1.  
0: Do not return recognition results.  
1: Return recognition results when complete sentences are detected.  
2: Return recognition results for both intermediate and complete sentences
parameters.help_zh:
开启会中实时结果返回时，设置识别结果返回等级，默认是1。
0：不返回识别结果。
1：识别出完整句子时返回识别结果。
2：识别出中间结果及完整句子时返回识别结果
parameters.name: realtime_result_level

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether MeetingKey and MeetingId are included in the header of real-time recognition message results during the meeting. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 会中识别消息结果header中是否包含MeetingKey、MeetingId，默认是false
parameters.name: realtime_result_meeting_info_enabled

parameters.help_en: Whether the in-meeting recognition message includes words information. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 会中识别消息是否包含words信息，默认是true
parameters.name: realtime_result_words_enabled

parameters.help_en: System extension: tag
parameters.help_zh: 系统扩展：标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: Translation Level for multi-channel Active stream recognition results. 0: Do not return translation results. 1: Return translation results when a complete sentence is recognized. 2: Return translation results for both intermediate and complete sentences. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 多通道Active流识别结果翻译等级。0：不返回翻译结果。 1：识别出完整句子时返回翻译结果。 2：识别出中间结果及完整句子时返回翻译结果。默认是1
parameters.name: translate_active_result_level

parameters.help_en: Collection of target languages for translation. Separate multiple languages with a comma (","). Currently supported languages are cn and en.
parameters.help_zh: 翻译目标语言集合，多个语言间用英文逗号","分隔，当前支持cn、en
parameters.name: translate_languages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable in-meeting translation. Default is false.
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启会中翻译，默认是false
parameters.name: translate_result_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Translation Level for single-channel detection or multi-channel mixed stream detection results.  
0: Do not return translation results.  
1: Return translation results when a complete sentence is detected.  
2: Return translation results for both intermediate results and complete sentences. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 单通道识别或多通道mix流识别结果翻译等级。0：不返回翻译结果。1：识别出完整句子时返回翻译结果。2：识别出中间结果及完整句子时返回翻译结果。默认是1
parameters.name: translate_result_level

MeetingKey.description_zh: 用户创建会议时设置的会议标识
MeetingKey.title_en: 用户创建会议时设置的会议标识。
MeetingKey.title_zh: 用户创建会议时设置的会议标识。

RequestId.description_en: Request ID, for joint debugging only.
